does_not_establish: Impossibility or insufficient capacity of the current GRU architecture
That adding more total examples without informative crossing will resolve transfer
Independent scientific admission or general language competence
interpretation.localized_failure: First recorded divergence is text-to-operand order on withheld word-by-layout combinations. Every wrong world is accompanied by wrong order and equals the reversed-action foil; canonical and native predictions on the same physical cases remain correct.
remaining_confounds: 3:1 current direct/inverse exposure with uneven word-by-layout counts
Optimization path versus representational inductive bias
Finite observed cells do not uniquely identify intended semantics on missing cells

method: stdlib-only arithmetic over immutable saved inputs, oracles, traces and summary; no model imports, forward passes, fitting or threshold changes

next_comparison.interpretation_limit: A matched two-arm result tests this inductive-bias hypothesis under the chosen evidence schedule; it cannot by itself separate all effects of evidence coverage, optimization and architecture. Learned factors and their interaction do not guarantee systematic composition. The opened lexical-v1 failure cells cannot be reused as a fresh holdout.
next_comparison.matching: Use the same observed training curriculum, training history, seeds, optimizer budget, exposure accounting and fresh word-by-layout holdout for both arms. A new factorized architecture cannot directly inherit GRU weights, so unmatched warm starts would confound the comparison.
next_comparison.proposal: Compare the 474-parameter GRU with learned lexical-content and layout-binding factors plus a small learned interaction, measuring actual parameter count at or below 474; no word, language, participant-role, polarity or order labels supplied to learning. Keep the acquired world model frozen and use outcome likelihood only.

retention_nll_changes.definition: Delta is updated encoder NLL minus archived parent encoder NLL on the exact same old-bank row; positive means worse probability despite unchanged MAP world.

row_reference_schema.case_sets: Deduplicated lists of [episode_id, step]. Each word_layout_cells record supplies the exact trace file, law and seed; its case_set contains every evaluated row, and wrong_case_set contains every erroneous row. Empty sets are explicit.
row_reference_schema.summary_support: Pair records and all full-bank retention NLL deltas are retained under structural_transfer and comparisons in the SHA-bound results/lexical-v1/summary.json.xz.

training_exposure_note: Each current update uses 768 outcome forecasts: 384 all-direct old TRAIN replay plus 384 balanced fresh forecasts, totaling 576 direct and 192 inverse (3:1). Historical bilingual language pretraining also saw only direct relation words. These are training exposures, not independent trials.

verification.diagnostic_status: Post-result descriptive localization; no changes to frozen thresholds, decisions, model parameters, source, or collected traces.
